items.title: Is AbbVie Stock About To Break Out Again?
items.summary: AbbVie's upside case now turns on one pending dosing change for the medicine that supplies close to a third of guided revenue, and management expects it to speed up sales.

items.title: Which Drugmaker Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Merck, Pfizer, or Amgen?
items.summary: One large-cap drugmaker has quietly lapped its peers in 2026 without a single obesity drug in its lineup, while the companies chasing the hottest trend in pharma are fighting for second place and last.

items.title: OPK Raises $125 Million Against Royalties: What Investors Should Know
items.summary: OPKO Health secured $125 million in royalty-backed financing, adding non-dilutive capital while retaining long-term exposure to mazdutide growth in China.

items.title: Is OPK Worth Buying as Valuation Meets Improving Business Trends?
items.summary: OPKO Health pairs a discounted forward sales multiple with narrowing losses and partnership support, but early-stage clinical risk keeps the investment case balanced.

items.title: OPK Climbs 12.4% in the Past Month: Can the Stock Rally Keep Going?
items.summary: OPKO Health's 12.4% monthly gain is backed by narrower losses and better margins, though profitability and clinical execution remain key risks.

items.title: ⚡Flash Heard: Why Healthcare Is Partying Like It’s Late 2020
items.summary: Moderna and Merck are surging today after the two companies said their experimental mRNA-based treatment succeeded in a late-stage study of high-risk melanoma patients.  The SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI) jumped nearly 5%, while the NYSE Arca Pharmaceutical Index climbed over 3%.  A positive clinical-trial result typically moves the companies developing the drug—and perhaps their closest competitors—not the entire healthcare sector.

items.title: Pfizer's Obesity Push: Can Berobenatide Take Market Share?
items.summary: PFE aims to break into the obesity market with berobenatide, a potential monthly treatment designed to compete with leading GLP-1 therapies.

items.title: Why 2026 Is Biotech’s Comeback Year
items.summary: Headwinds in the sector are clearing. That is good news for venture firms seeking liquidity and for a stock market looking for growth stories, Nilesh Kumar writes in a guest commentary.
